evidence: deepseek: "if count == k: return True" and "Try to find an independent set of size k"; gpt-oss: "answer_mask = 0" and "found = False"
removal_suggestion: Replace the arbitrary-witness requirement with a canonical-output requirement: if a solution exists, output the lexicographically largest valid k-marker set. This prevents returning the first feasible set and requires exhaustive comparison.

survivor_shortcuts.shortcut: Depth-first search stops immediately after finding any independent set of size k.
Bitmask recursive search is designed to record one feasible answer rather than compare all feasible answers.

defeated_student_causes.why_failed: It explicitly enumerates combinations, which becomes too slow on the largest inputs.
Its minimum-degree greedy heuristic is not guaranteed to find an independent set of the required size.

recommended_edit: Change the output requirement from accepting any valid set to requiring the lexicographically largest valid set among all valid selections.
